terra.problem: Saying David has nothing to hide makes a broader claim about him than the passage establishes.
Saying David is not hiding his tracks makes a broader claim about him than the passage establishes.
Nabal says he does not know the men's origin. The explanation treats that claim as fact and gives it as the reason he gives them nothing.
The passage says the meat was slaughtered for Nabal's shearers, but it does not establish that the feast was not a family table.
The passage does not say that nobody is sick. It says the young man warns of disaster.
Calling David a man on the run adds a fact not established in this passage. A fact from elsewhere needs a reference.
Saying the party is over for Nabal makes light of his serious condition.
The passage does not establish that Nabal never moves anywhere before he dies.
The passage says David straps on his sword, but it does not say whether he draws it. It cannot establish that his sword never comes out.
Saying Abigail is one of two wives overlooks Michal, whom the next verse also calls David's wife.
The passage does not establish that these changes happened in a short stretch.
